method: Unique packed UV0 islands; area-normalized island scale. Saved Custom Primitive Data[0] = mesh sampling factor * actual uniform placed world scale. Material samples UV0 * CPD[0]. Generated surface images repeat intentionally; surfaces have separate non-overlapping authoring UVs, not bespoke painted per-instance atlases.

SM_Pine_0.repair: Triangulation, removed zero-area tips, 1 degree surface projection

exceptions: Curved surfaces retain measured within-island projection stretch; per-mesh area-RMS density is 128 px/m, percentile ranges reported.
Uniform scales only; all 889 placed prop scales checked. Future changed actor scales require CPD update.
Terrain detail uses world XY at 127.908 px/m horizontally; slope lowers surface density.
Water and foam use world-space animated coordinates; no finite albedo texel density. Caustic image uses world projection.
NPOT 1254-square original images use no mipmaps; full native texel density is the reported value.
